text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the RFC: thinking we need a minimal, forward-compatible fieldset for rollout metadata: `release_stamp`, `lock_token`, `lock_scope` (tenant|global), and an optional `ttl_secs`. want to float this before i open the PR.
andre: Can we make `lock_scope` default to tenant-scoped? most issues have come from accidental global pins.
lin: +1 for tenant default. also recommend adding `schema_version` to the metadata so clients can opt-in to newer semantics (`meta_v2`).
devon: Migration question: we have thousands of pins with just `pin` today. If we auto-upgrade them to meta_v2 with synthesized tokens, how do we avoid a churn storm on the placement service?
maya: propose a staged migrate: 1) read-only shim: treat `pin` as legacy `release_stamp`; 2) background job creates meta_v2 entries only on first write or when tenant touches model; 3) admin-run bulk for tenants that request it.
sam: ops-bot: sched-bot ran schema-lint across prod sample: ~0.9% of model entries have malformed `pin` (non-string). those will fail auto-synth, need a manual fallback.
andre: For runtime semantics, acquire should be compare-and-swap style: `cas_acquire(model, scope, expected_stamp, token, ttl)` -> success/failure + current. also a `force_release` for ops with audit log.
lin: Implementation note: make `lock_token` opaque (64 chars) and sign it server-side so clients can't forge. Token contents: random + hmac(schema_version|tenant|model).
devon: Concern: if ttl is optional, we must ensure an active reconciler clears locks older than e.g. 90d. otherwise stale legacy locks block rollouts.
maya: agree. let's enforce a reconciler for meta_v2 and for legacy `pin` entries mark them as "ephemeral_legacy" with default soft-ttl 30d. include telemetry: lock_age, lock_scope, lock_churn.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging check: new field `schema_version` missing in 2024-10-02 deploys.
andre: I'll add schema validation to server side with a permissive warning window for 14 days before hard reject. also add explicit `migrate_pin_to_meta_v2` flag in the admin UI.
lin: Developer API sketch: ```POST /models/:id/lock
body: { "scope": "tenant", "expected_stamp": "v2.1.0", "token": "<client-provided-or-empty>", "ttl_secs": 3600 }
res: { "ok": true, "token": "<server-token>", "expires_at": "2024-10-03T12:34:56Z", "current_stamp": "v2.1.0" }
```
maya: Action items: i'll open the doc PR outlining migration phases + reconciler behavior; @andre to add server-side permissive validation + admin flag; @lin to draft token signing spec and API contract. thanks! :rocket:
